purpose: Freeze a modality-agnostic and query-independent PCA40 relation transform for canonical official C-RADIO DINOv3 primitive rows before any downstream query-conditioned selector consumes it.
scope: Any benchmark scene with a canonical capability cache satisfying the exact source signature; the transform opens no query, annotation, target RGB, target mask, or metric.

source_acceptance.storage_dtype: float16 converted to float32 before statistics
source_acceptance.row_population: all and only capability-valid primitive rows in ascending global-row order

transform.standardization: per-dimension torch float32 mean and sample standard deviation with correction=1
transform.implementation: sklearn.decomposition.PCA with svd_solver=auto, random_state=None, and NumPy global seed 0
transform.subsample_rule: if rows exceed 500000, np.random.choice without replacement after np.random.seed(0); otherwise fit all rows
transform.projection: subtract fitted PCA mean and right-multiply by fitted components transpose
transform.eigenvalue_weighting: multiply projected coordinates by fitted PCA singular values
transform.copy_false_note: The memory-bounded builder may use PCA(copy=False); this changes allocation only and preserves the registered numerical transform.

compatibility_boundary.reason: LUDVIG fits standardized PCA40 on native 1536-D DINOv2 ViT-g image patch tokens before inverse-render uplift. This transform fits already-uplifted, L2-normalized, float16 4096-D official C-RADIO DINOv3 primitive rows.
compatibility_boundary.allowed_claim: query-independent C-RADIO DINOv3 primitive PCA40 relation diagnostic with LUDVIG-inspired transform semantics
